title: Health
description: Live process and dependency checks. Auto-refreshes every {{seconds}} seconds. The liveness probe ({{live}}) is unauthenticated for load balancers and uptime monitors; the full report ({{ready}}) needs Health.View.
probe.liveness.title: Liveness
probe.liveness.description: Process is up and serving requests. No external dependencies are checked.
probe.readiness.title: All checks
probe.readiness.description: Every registered dependency check with its details, also the ones the readiness probe skips (file storage). The anonymous readiness probe answers the overall status only.
